title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL

paragraphs.en: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone . The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO’s 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 人们不仅通过重复成功的行动来学习，还通过回顾和解释自己的经历，修正自己的理解以指导未来的行为。 语言模型智能体是否仅通过训练自己经历的解释，就能改进其未来的行动？ 我们通过研究“仅回顾式微调”（Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning, ROFT）来探讨这个问题。这是一种极简的在线流程，旨在孤立地考察仅基于解释的训练对后续行为的影响。 智能体尝试执行一项任务，观察可用的反馈，生成回顾性解释，并仅针对该解释中的词元使用下一个词预测损失进行微调。 该流程既不使用外部教师模型，也不采用基于奖励的策略更新方法。 在基于 Qwen3.5-4B 的软件工程实验中，ROFT 是在基础模型尝试成功与失败混合的问题上进行训练的。 在未使用的 SWE-bench Verified 和 Pro 测试集上，经过 20 次更新后，其任务解决率分别达到 49.2% 和 26.8%，且无需使用验证器；相比之下，在评估运行中，GRPO 经过 40 次更新后的解决率仅为 48.0% 和 25.3%，而 ROFT 在训练时间和采样尝试次数上也实现了更快的早期进展。 它还能学会解决那些基础模型全部 64 次采样尝试均未成功的具体任务，这表明学习过程无需任何初始成功的轨迹即可开始。 行为分析发现，ROFT 会间接地将成功归因于特定行动，从而鼓励良好行动并抑制错误行动。 此外，若提示回顾过程更强调直接有效的解决方案，即使没有明确的长度惩罚，后续尝试也会变得更短。 综合来看，这些发现表明学习解释能力也能提升执行任务的能力，确立了自我生成的回顾性解释作为有效的训练目标，并推动了对“从解释到行动”迁移机制的进一步研究。

paragraphs.en: We sometimes understand an experience differently in the act of recounting it. Explaining why a conversation went badly, someone might begin with “I did not make my point clearly enough.” But as they reconstruct the exchange, another explanation emerges: they kept defending their proposal while the other person was questioning its premise. The lesson is no longer to explain the same point more forcefully, but to establish which question needs answering. Nothing about the original outcome has changed. What changes is their understanding of what happened—and, with it, how they might act next time. For language-model agents, this suggests a complementary training target: not only the actions taken during an attempt, but retrospective explanations that make sense of the experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在复述经历时，有时会对它产生不同的理解。 在解释一场对话为何不顺利时，有人可能会先说：“我没有把自己的观点表达得足够清楚。”但当他们重构对话过程时，另一种解释便会浮现：他们一直在为自己的提议辩护，而对方却在质疑其前提。 由此得出的教训不再是更有力地阐述同一个观点，而是明确究竟需要回答哪个问题。 最初的结果本身并没有任何改变。 改变的是他们对所发生事情的理解——以及随之而来的、下次可能采取的行动方式。 对于语言模型智能体而言，这意味着一个互补的训练目标：不仅要训练执行尝试过程中的行动，还要训练能够解释整个经历的回顾性说明。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers an effective way to learn from experience by reinforcing task-solving behavior according to its outcomes ( Lambert et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) . Methods such as GRPO use relative rewards among sampled attempts to update the policy ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Yet a single outcome reward, success or failure, does not identify which assumption was mistaken, which decision mattered, or when a correction should apply. This limitation is especially relevant when rewards are sparse: an all-failure group has no within-group binary-reward contrast, even though its trajectories may contain useful evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提供了一种有效的经验学习方法，即根据任务解决行为的结果对其进行强化（Lambert 等，2024；DeepSeek-AI 等，2025）。 像 GRPO 这样的方法利用采样尝试之间的相对奖励来更新策略（Shao 等，2024）。 然而，单一的结果奖励——成功或失败——无法确定哪个假设是错误的、哪个决策是关键，或者何时应进行修正。 当奖励稀疏时，这一局限性尤为明显：一个全部失败的群体内部没有二元奖励的对比，尽管其轨迹可能包含有用的证据。

paragraphs.en: Natural language can express an interpretation of that evidence, connecting observations to decisions and stating lessons that may apply elsewhere. Prior work has used reflections in several ways: as context for later attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , or to obtain successful reasoning and reflection-informed solutions for training ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . Critique fine-tuning, which trains on critiques as a form of reflection, demonstrates that teacher critiques can be transferred offline to a student to improve its question-answering performance ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . However, it remains unclear whether training only on self-generated reflection can improve agents. The central question is therefore:
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言可以表达对这些证据的一种解释，将观察结果与决策联系起来，并陈述可能适用于其他情境的教训。 先前的研究以多种方式利用了反思：作为后续尝试的背景（Shinn 等人，2023），或用于获取成功的推理以及基于反思的解决方案以进行训练（Zelikman 等人，2022；Shi 等人，2026）。 批判性微调（critique fine-tuning）通过在批判性反馈上进行训练（将其视为一种反思形式）表明，教师的批判性反馈可以离线迁移给学生，从而提升其问答性能（Wang 等人，2025b；Wang 等人，2026）。 然而，仅通过自我生成的反思进行训练是否能让智能体得到提升，目前仍不清楚。 因此，核心问题是：

paragraphs.en: We call this direction Retrospection Reinforcement (RR) : training on self-generated retrospections of past experience, with the aim of improving subsequent behavior. A retrospection may summarize events, track how beliefs evolved, explain decisions or outcomes, identify corrections, or articulate lessons for future attempts. Our procedure trains on this retrospective text rather than directly supervising the recorded task-solving actions. The hypothesis is that learning to explain an experience can improve how the model acts in later attempts. We assess this hypothesis through subsequent task performance and behavior changes, not through the fluency of explanations or a reduction in their prediction loss.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一方向称为“回顾强化”（Retrospection Reinforcement，RR）：即基于对过往经历自行生成的回顾性描述进行训练，旨在改善后续行为。 一次回顾性描述可以总结事件经过、追踪信念如何演变、解释决策或结果、识别需要修正之处，或明确未来尝试中应吸取的教训。 我们的方法基于这些回顾性文本进行训练，而非直接对记录的任务执行动作进行监督。 我们的假设是，学会解释一次经历能够提升模型在后续尝试中的表现。 我们通过模型在后续任务中的表现和行为变化来验证这一假设，而非通过解释的流畅度或预测损失的降低来评估。

sents.zh: 我们的假设是，学会解释一次经历能够提升模型在后续尝试中的表现。

paragraphs.en: To study this route in isolation, we introduce Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT) , a deliberately minimal online procedure. The agent attempts a task, observes the outcome and available feedback, and generates a retrospection of its own attempt. We then fine-tune the same model with a next-token prediction loss on the retrospection tokens only. The task, attempted actions, and observations serve as context, not prediction targets. Both successful and unsuccessful attempts are eligible, and the procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. Subsequent attempts receive no stored retrospection and require no additional reflection step: any benefit must transfer through the updated weights. These exclusions make simplicity an experimental choice, isolating what retrospection training can contribute without direct action supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 为了单独研究这一路线，我们引入了“仅回顾微调”（ROFT），这是一种刻意设计的极简在线流程。 智能体会尝试执行一项任务，观察结果和可用反馈，并生成对自己尝试过程的回顾。 接着，我们仅针对这些回顾标记，使用下一个词元预测损失对同一模型进行微调。 任务、尝试过的动作和观察结果仅作为上下文，而非预测目标。 无论成功与否的尝试都符合要求，且该流程既不使用外部教师，也不采用基于奖励的策略更新。 后续尝试不会获得任何已存储的回顾信息，也无需额外的反思步骤：任何收益都必须通过更新后的权重传递。 这些排除项使简洁性成为一种实验性选择，从而孤立出回顾训练所能带来的贡献，而无需直接的动作监督。

paragraphs.en: Our software-engineering experiments provide evidence that learning to explain can improve learning to do. First, when trained on problems with both successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts—the learning zone —ROFT achieves higher held-out solve rates than GRPO at the reported checkpoints, with faster early progress in wall-clock time and sampled solution attempts ( ), without a verifier. Second, it learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, extending learning beyond the frontier without an initially successful trajectory or variation in binary outcomes ( ). Third, behavioral analyses find changes consistent with indirect credit assignment: likelihood increases are more selective for correct than incorrect recorded turns. Changing the retrospection prompt to emphasize more direct solutions also produces shorter subsequent attempts, despite the absence of an explicit length penalty or action-target loss ( ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的软件工程实验表明，学习解释能够提升学习执行的能力。 首先，当在包含成功和失败基础模型尝试的问题（即“学习区”）上进行训练时，ROFT 在报告的检查点处比 GRPO 获得了更高的保留集解决率，并且在实际时间和采样解决方案尝试方面表现出更快的早期进展（），且无需验证器。 其次，它能够解决那些所有 64 次基础模型尝试均未成功的单个任务，从而在没有初始成功轨迹或二元结果差异的情况下，将学习范围扩展到了现有边界之外（）。 第三，行为分析发现的变化与间接信用分配一致：正确记录回合的可能性增加比错误记录回合更为显著。 将回顾提示改为更强调直接解决方案的形式后，尽管没有明确的长度惩罚或动作目标损失（），后续尝试的长度也变得更短了。

sents.en: Our software-engineering experiments provide evidence that learning to explain can improve learning to do.
sents.zh: 我们的软件工程实验表明，学习解释能够提升学习执行的能力。

sents.en: First, when trained on problems with both successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts—the learning zone —ROFT achieves higher held-out solve rates than GRPO at the reported checkpoints, with faster early progress in wall-clock time and sampled solution attempts ( ), without a verifier.
sents.zh: 首先，当在包含成功和失败基础模型尝试的问题（即“学习区”）上进行训练时，ROFT 在报告的检查点处比 GRPO 获得了更高的保留集解决率，并且在实际时间和采样解决方案尝试方面表现出更快的早期进展（），且无需验证器。

sents.en: Second, it learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, extending learning beyond the frontier without an initially successful trajectory or variation in binary outcomes ( ).
sents.zh: 其次，它能够解决那些所有 64 次基础模型尝试均未成功的单个任务，从而在没有初始成功轨迹或二元结果差异的情况下，将学习范围扩展到了现有边界之外（）。

sents.en: Third, behavioral analyses find changes consistent with indirect credit assignment: likelihood increases are more selective for correct than incorrect recorded turns.
sents.zh: 第三，行为分析发现的变化与间接信用分配一致：正确记录回合的可能性增加比错误记录回合更为显著。

sents.en: Changing the retrospection prompt to emphasize more direct solutions also produces shorter subsequent attempts, despite the absence of an explicit length penalty or action-target loss ( ).
sents.zh: 将回顾提示改为更强调直接解决方案的形式后，尽管没有明确的长度惩罚或动作目标损失（），后续尝试的长度也变得更短了。

paragraphs.en: These results suggest a complementary design axis for agent training: not only which experiences to learn from, but what to learn to say about them. Our results show that experience can support useful training targets even when binary outcomes provide no contrast or in the absence of any outcome verdict. The prompt-dependent behavioral changes further suggest that the content of those targets matters: changing what an agent emphasizes in retrospection can change how it subsequently acts. Retrospection is therefore not merely a record of experience, but a potentially steerable source of supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，智能体训练存在一个互补的设计维度：不仅要学习哪些经验，还要学习如何对这些经验进行描述。 我们的研究结果显示，即使二元结果无法提供对比信息，或者在没有任何结果判定的情况下，经验仍然可以支持有效的训练目标。 提示依赖的行为变化进一步表明，这些训练目标的内容至关重要：改变智能体在回顾时强调的内容，可能会影响其后续的行为方式。 因此，回顾不仅仅是经验的记录，更是一个可以被引导的监督来源。

paragraphs.en: An unsuccessful attempt may be a poor example to imitate but still provide useful experience to interpret. Here, we describe how an agent can be trained exclusively on retrospections of its own experience and evaluated on its subsequent task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 一次失败的尝试可能是一个不值得模仿的糟糕例子，但仍能为解读提供有用的经验。 在此，我们描述了一种方法：智能体可以仅基于对自身经验的回顾进行训练，并通过其后续的任务表现进行评估。

sents.en: An unsuccessful attempt may be a poor example to imitate but still provide useful experience to interpret.
sents.zh: 一次失败的尝试可能是一个不值得模仿的糟糕例子，但仍能为解读提供有用的经验。

sents.en: Here, we describe how an agent can be trained exclusively on retrospections of its own experience and evaluated on its subsequent task performance.
sents.zh: 在此，我们描述了一种方法：智能体可以仅基于对自身经验的回顾进行训练，并通过其后续的任务表现进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Learning to do directly optimizes task-solving outputs, including reasoning, answers, and actions. Reward-based updates, imitation, and distillation can all serve this purpose. Learning to explain instead trains the model to produce a retrospective account of a completed attempt. We call this direction Retrospection Reinforcement (RR) .
paragraphs.zh: 直接学习执行任务能够优化任务解决成果，包括推理、答案和行动。 基于奖励的更新、模仿和蒸馏都可以实现这一目的。 而学习解释则训练模型生成对已完成尝试的回顾性说明。 我们将这一方向称为回顾强化（RR）。

sents.en: Learning to do directly optimizes task-solving outputs, including reasoning, answers, and actions.
sents.zh: 直接学习执行任务能够优化任务解决成果，包括推理、答案和行动。

sents.en: Reward-based updates, imitation, and distillation can all serve this purpose.
sents.zh: 基于奖励的更新、模仿和蒸馏都可以实现这一目的。

sents.en: Learning to explain instead trains the model to produce a retrospective account of a completed attempt.
sents.zh: 而学习解释则训练模型生成对已完成尝试的回顾性说明。

sents.en: We call this direction Retrospection Reinforcement (RR) .
sents.zh: 我们将这一方向称为回顾强化（RR）。

paragraphs.en: A retrospection is a textual account of past experience, generated in light of the recorded interaction and any available feedback. Its form can range from a trajectory summary or a ledger of evolving beliefs to an explanation of decisions or outcomes, a correction, or a reusable lesson. No particular content structure is required. Retrospections may discuss actions and possible corrections; the distinction is between training on a post-attempt account and directly supervising task-solving actions. contrasts direct action training with retrospection prediction, where the recorded attempt supplies context rather than prediction targets. Our hypothesis is that learning to explain an experience changes the knowledge and representations available when the same model next acts. Below, we describe a minimal algorithm for studying this hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 回顾性陈述是对过往经历的文字描述，它基于已记录交互以及任何可用反馈生成。 其形式可以是轨迹摘要或信念演变记录，也可以是决策或结果的解释、修正，或是可复用的经验教训。 不要求采用特定的内容结构。 回顾性陈述可以讨论行动及可能的修正；关键区别在于，这是基于尝试后的描述进行训练，而非直接监督任务执行行动。这与直接行动训练形成对比：在回顾性预测中，记录下来的尝试提供上下文背景，而非预测目标。 我们的假设是，学会解释某种经历会改变同一模型在后续行动中可用的知识与表示形式。 下文我们将描述一种用于验证这一假设的最简算法。

paragraphs.en: Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT) repeats a simple loop: attempt a task, explain the experience, fit the explanation, and act again using the updated weights. We exclude direct action supervision and retained retrospection so that neither can account for an improvement in doing.

Any benefit must therefore transfer through the updated weights, rather than through access to a written lesson. This closes the loop between explaining and doing while keeping their training targets distinct. Sampling settings, target processing, batch construction, and asynchronous weight refresh are specified in .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate explanation-to-action transfer through three questions. Does retrospection-only training improve held-out solve rates, and at what training cost? Can learning begin when all sampled base model attempts fail? Does retrospection content shape subsequent behavior as measured by action-likelihood changes, interventions on retrospection instructions, and changes to content weighting? These questions assess behavioral transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个问题来评估从解释到行动的迁移效果。 仅通过回顾性训练能否提高保留测试集的解决率，其训练成本又是多少？ 当所有采样基础模型的尝试都失败时，学习是否仍能开始？ 回顾性内容是否会通过行动可能性变化、对回顾性指令的干预以及内容权重的调整来影响后续行为？ 这些问题旨在评估行为的迁移效果。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish two learning regimes using sampled base-model outcomes. A problem is in the learning zone if the base model produces both successful and unsuccessful solutions across k k sampled attempts; it is beyond frontier if none of those attempts succeeds. illustrates the distinction for Qwen3.5-4B on all 500 SWE-bench Verified problems using 16 attempts per problem. The experiments below use three attempts to screen the learning-zone training subset and 64 attempts to establish the all-failure starting points for single-task training.

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate generalization and efficiency in the learning zone by comparing ROFT and GRPO initialized from Qwen3.5-4B and trained on SWE-rebench-767, a subset of 767 problems from SWE-rebench ( Badertdinov et al., 2025 ) . Our training subset is specifically selected to favor GRPO : because its reward-derived policy-gradient signal requires variation in rewards within a group, we retain only problems on which Qwen3.5-4B produces both successful and unsuccessful solutions across three initial attempts. We assess held-out performance on SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . All three datasets require agents to resolve real-world repository issues by producing code patches evaluated against executable tests. SWE-bench Verified comprises 500 human-validated Python tasks, whereas SWE-bench Pro emphasizes more complex, long-horizon tasks that often require substantial changes across multiple files. Qwen3.5-4B performance is 44.2% and 23.9% on Verified and Pro respectively in our setup.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在学习区通过比较基于 Qwen3.5-4B 初始化并在 SWE-rebench-767（SWE-rebench 中 767 个问题的子集，Badertdinov 等人，2025）上训练的 ROFT 和 GRPO，来评估其泛化能力和效率。 我们的训练子集是专门挑选以利于 GRPO 的：由于其基于奖励的策略梯度信号需要组内奖励的变化，因此我们仅保留 Qwen3.5-4B 在三次初始尝试中同时产生成功和失败解决方案的问题。 我们在 SWE-bench Verified（OpenAI，2024）和 SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等人，2025）上评估了模型在未训练数据上的表现。 这三个数据集都要求智能体通过生成可执行测试验证的代码补丁来解决真实世界中的仓库问题。 SWE-bench Verified 包含 500 个经过人类验证的 Python 任务，而 SWE-bench Pro 则更侧重于复杂且长期执行的任务，这些任务通常需要跨多个文件进行较大规模的修改。 在我们的实验设置中，Qwen3.5-4B 在 Verified 和 Pro 数据集上的表现分别为 44.2% 和 23.9%。

sents.en: Qwen3.5-4B performance is 44.2% and 23.9% on Verified and Pro respectively in our setup.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验设置中，Qwen3.5-4B 在 Verified 和 Pro 数据集上的表现分别为 44.2% 和 23.9%。

paragraphs.en: ROFT achieves higher held-out solve rates on both benchmarks in : its 20-update checkpoint reaches 49.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 29.0% on SWE-bench Pro, compared with 48.0% and 25.3% for GRPO at 40 updates. These gains do not require continued improvement in training reward. ROFT’s training curve levels off around 20 updates, whereas GRPO’s reward continues to improve with longer training. Yet GRPO’s Verified solve rate falls from 48.0% at update 40 to 46.0% at update 90 ( ), a pattern consistent with overfitting to the training tasks. We hypothesize that ROFT’s early saturation reflects increasingly repetitive retrospections as training revisits familiar tasks, reducing the new supervision they provide, which is consistent with decreasing reflection entropy and SFT loss. See for details.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个基准测试中，ROFT 都实现了更高的保留集解决率：其 20 次更新的检查点在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到了 49.2%，在 SWE-bench Pro 上达到了 29.0%，而 GRPO 在 40 次更新时的对应数据为 48.0% 和 25.3%。 这些提升并不需要在训练奖励上持续改进。 ROFT 的训练曲线在大约 20 次更新后趋于平缓，而 GRPO 的奖励则随着训练时间的延长而持续提升。 然而，GRPO 的 Verified 解决率从第 40 次更新的 48.0% 下降到了第 90 次更新的 46.0%（），这一模式与对训练任务的过拟合一致。 我们推测，ROFT 的早期饱和反映了随着训练重访熟悉任务时，回顾过程变得越来越重复，从而减少了它们所提供的新监督；这与反射熵和 SFT 损失的下降是一致的。详见。

paragraphs.en: Starting from Qwen3.5-4B and training on SWE-rebench-767, ROFT makes faster early progress than GRPO in terms of wall-clock time, optimizer updates, and sampled solution attempts ( ). With the same allocation of four training and four inference GPUs, ROFT completes 40 updates in 4.32 hours using 6,035 solution attempts, compared with 8.30 hours and 11,576 attempts for GRPO, i.e. approximately half the training time and half as many solution attempts. This early advantage also transfers to held-out performance: ROFT solves 49.0% of SWE-bench Verified after ten updates and 1.29 hours, exceeding the 48.0% achieved by GRPO’s 40-update checkpoint, which takes 8.30 hours ( ). Thus, ROFT attains a higher observed test score in roughly one-sixth the training time.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Qwen3.5-4B 开始并在 SWE-rebench-767 上进行训练，ROFT 在墙钟时间、优化器更新和采样解决方案尝试次数方面比 GRPO 更早取得进展（）。 在同样分配四块训练 GPU 和四块推理 GPU 的情况下，ROFT 使用 6,035 次解决方案尝试，在 4.32 小时内完成了 40 次更新；而 GRPO 则需要 8.30 小时和 11,576 次尝试，也就是说 ROFT 的训练时间约为后者的一半，解决方案尝试次数也减少了一半。 这种早期优势也延续到了保留集上的表现：ROFT 在十次更新和 1.29 小时后解决了 SWE-bench Verified 中 49.0% 的任务，超过了 GRPO 在 40 次更新检查点时实现的 48.0%，而后者需要 8.30 小时（）。 因此，ROFT 在大约六分之一的训练时间内就达到了更高的观测测试分数。

paragraphs.en: We next ask whether learning can begin without any observed successful base-model attempts, rather than only on the mixed-success problems. With binary success rewards, an all-failure GRPO group has zero within-group advantage and provides no reward-derived policy-gradient signal, so GRPO does not learn in this regime. ROFT instead obtains supervision from retrospections of failed attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们探讨一个问题：学习是否可以在没有任何观察到的基础模型成功尝试的情况下开始，而不仅仅依赖于那些成功与失败混合的问题。 在二元成功奖励机制下，一个全部失败的 GRPO 群体其组内优势为零，也无法提供任何源自奖励的策略梯度信号，因此 GRPO 在这种模式下无法学习。 相比之下，ROFT 则通过回顾失败的尝试来获取监督信息。

sents.en: We next ask whether learning can begin without any observed successful base-model attempts, rather than only on the mixed-success problems.

sents.en: With binary success rewards, an all-failure GRPO group has zero within-group advantage and provides no reward-derived policy-gradient signal, so GRPO does not learn in this regime.

sents.en: ROFT instead obtains supervision from retrospections of failed attempts.
sents.zh: 相比之下，ROFT 则通过回顾失败的尝试来获取监督信息。

paragraphs.en: To study an all-failure starting point, we train separate Qwen3.5-4B runs on individual SWE-bench Verified and SWE-rebench tasks, each beginning with 0/64 successful base model attempts on that task and using only self-generated retrospections for supervision. After 40 updates, the online solve rate reaches 1.75% on SymPy and 3.29% on SymbiFlow ( ). Thus, retrospection-only training can produce successful solutions from an all-failure starting point. Training on a single problem with ROFT does not degrade test-set performance significantly ( ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究一个完全失败的初始状态，我们对 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-rebench 中的单个任务分别训练独立的 Qwen3.5-4B 智能体实例，每个实例都以该任务上基础模型 0/64 次尝试成功为起点，并且仅使用自我生成的回顾性分析进行监督。 经过 40 次更新后，在线解决率在 SymPy 上达到 1.75%，在 SymbiFlow 上达到 3.29%（）。 因此，仅通过回顾性分析的训练也能从完全失败的初始状态中产生成功的解决方案。 使用 ROFT 对单个问题进行训练并不会显著降低测试集上的性能（）。

paragraphs.en: Can retrospection-only training assign credit to individual actions? We evaluate a fixed set of base model trajectories on SWE-rebench-767, with assistant turns labeled for correctness by GPT-6 Astra using the recorded evidence. For each turn, including both reasoning and actions, we compare its mean token log-likelihood under the initial Qwen3.5-4B model and after ten optimizer updates of ROFT or GRPO, conditioning on the same recorded history. shows the fraction of turns whose likelihood increases, computed separately for each correctness label within each trajectory and then averaged equally across trajectories containing that label. Under RR, correct turns increase in likelihood more often than incorrect turns (32.41% versus 21.21%), whereas GRPO shows similar rates for both (44.14% versus 45.30%). This separation is consistent with indirect credit assignment without direct action supervision. See for details.
paragraphs.zh: 仅通过回顾性训练能否将功劳归于单个行动？ 我们在 SWE-rebench-767 上评估一组固定的基础模型轨迹，其中助手回合的正确性由 GPT-6 Astra 根据记录的证据进行标注。 对于每个回合（包括推理和行动），我们比较其在初始 Qwen3.5-4B 模型下的平均词元对数似然，以及经过 ROFT 或 GRPO 十次优化器更新后的平均值，同时以相同的记录历史为条件。图中显示了似然值增加的回合比例，该比例在每条轨迹内按每个正确性标签分别计算，然后对包含该标签的轨迹进行等权平均。 在 RR 方法下，正确回合的似然值增加频率高于错误回合（32.41% 对比 21.21%），而 GRPO 在这两类回合中表现出相似的比例（44.14% 对比 45.30%）。 这种分离现象与间接功劳分配且无直接行动监督的情况一致。详见相关说明。

paragraphs.en: Can the content of retrospection steer subsequent task-solving behavior? We compare standard ROFT with a variant that asks the model to identify how it could have solved the task more directly after a successful attempt while preserving correctness. Both runs use the same initialization, training data, solver prompt, and retrospection-only objective. The variant uses 11.7% fewer generated assistant tokens and 13.1% fewer assistant turns than the baseline ( ). These observations are consistent with content-directed behavioral change from training on retrospections alone, without an explicit length penalty or action-target supervision. gives the experimental procedure, complete prompts, and detailed results.
paragraphs.zh: 回顾性反思的内容能否引导后续的任务解决行为？ 我们将标准的 ROFT 与一个变体进行比较，该变体要求模型在成功尝试后，识别出它本可以如何更直接地完成任务，同时保持正确性。 两次运行均使用相同的初始化、训练数据、求解器提示词以及仅基于回顾性反思的目标函数。 该变体生成的助手令牌比基线少 11.7%，助手轮次也少 13.1%（ ）。 这些观察结果与仅通过回顾性反思训练而实现的内容导向型行为变化一致，且无需显式的长度惩罚或动作目标监督。提供了实验流程、完整提示词和详细结果。

sents.zh: 我们将标准的 ROFT 与一个变体进行比较，该变体要求模型在成功尝试后，识别出它本可以如何更直接地完成任务，同时保持正确性。

sents.en: Both runs use the same initialization, training data, solver prompt, and retrospection-only objective.
sents.zh: 两次运行均使用相同的初始化、训练数据、求解器提示词以及仅基于回顾性反思的目标函数。

sents.en: The variant uses 11.7% fewer generated assistant tokens and 13.1% fewer assistant turns than the baseline ( ).
sents.zh: 该变体生成的助手令牌比基线少 11.7%，助手轮次也少 13.1%（ ）。

sents.en: These observations are consistent with content-directed behavioral change from training on retrospections alone, without an explicit length penalty or action-target supervision. gives the experimental procedure, complete prompts, and detailed results.
sents.zh: 这些观察结果与仅通过回顾性反思训练而实现的内容导向型行为变化一致，且无需显式的长度惩罚或动作目标监督。提供了实验流程、完整提示词和详细结果。

paragraphs.en: Where does learning to explain change the model’s subsequent action predictions? We isolate a single retrospection-only update of Qwen3.5-4B on 255 retrospections from 64 source attempts, then compare the full next-token distributions before and after training on the same original rollout prefixes. Among the mechanically identified roles, reasoning has the largest task-balanced mean forward KL, a 3.45 × 3.45\times difference from tool calls ( ). Changes are also concentrated earlier in the rollout: the first normalized assistant-turn decile has the largest mean KL ( ). Read/search contexts shift more than modification contexts: the task-balanced mean KL for Glob and Read is 1.35 1.35 – 1.89 1.89 times that for Write and Edit across the four pairwise comparisons. These patterns are consistent with transfer to reasoning and information gathering despite the absence of action-target supervision. See for details.
paragraphs.zh: 学习解释会如何改变模型后续的动作预测？ 我们从 64 个源尝试中提取了 255 次回顾，仅对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行一次回顾性更新，然后比较在相同原始展开前缀上进行训练前后完整的下一个词元分布。 在机械识别出的角色中，推理具有最大的任务平衡平均前向 KL，与工具调用相比差异为 3.45 × 3.45\times（ ）。 变化也集中在展开过程的早期阶段：第一个归一化的助手回合十分位具有最大的平均 KL（ ）。 阅读/搜索上下文的变化幅度大于修改上下文：在四组两两比较中，Glob 和 Read 的任务平衡平均 KL 是 Write 和 Edit 的 1.35 – 1.89 倍。 这些模式与向推理和信息收集能力的迁移一致，尽管没有动作目标的监督。详见 。

paragraphs.en: Does emphasizing particular retrospection content improve subsequent task solving? Using the same frozen retrospections, we compare uniform target weights (Uniform) with variants that double the relative weight of evidence, task-specific corrections, reusable lessons, or thinking tokens. GPT-6 Astra labels the evidence, correction, and lesson categories; thinking tokens are identified mechanically. Attention-up instead weights each nonstructural target token by one plus the base model’s mean attention mass to the user prompt when predicting it. All variants receive one update from the same base model, with weights normalized to mean one across the target batch. We evaluate each checkpoint on the same 64 training problems with ten paired evaluation seeds, yielding 640 attempts per model. Attention-up, correction-up, and evidence-up have the highest observed solve rates among these variants: 54.69%, 54.38%, and 54.22%, respectively, versus 50.63% for Uniform ( ).
paragraphs.zh: 强调特定的回顾内容是否有助于后续任务解决？ 使用相同的冻结回顾内容，我们将统一目标权重（Uniform）与多种变体进行比较：这些变体分别将证据、任务特定修正、可复用经验或思考标记的相对权重加倍。 GPT-6 Astra 对证据、修正和经验类别进行标注；思考标记则通过机械方式识别。 Attention-up 在预测每个非结构化的目标标记时，将其权重设为 1 加上基础模型对该用户提示的平均注意力分配值。 所有变体均从同一基础模型接收一次更新，且权重在整个目标批次中归一化为均值 1。 我们在相同的 64 个训练问题上评估每个检查点，并使用十个配对的评估种子，从而为每个模型生成 640 次尝试。 在这些变体中，Attention-up、Correction-up 和 Evidence-up 的观察到的解决率最高，分别为 54.69%、54.38% 和 54.22%，而 Uniform 的解决率为 50.63%（ ）。

paragraphs.en: We hypothesize that RR improves behavior by refining the model’s understanding of an experience rather than directly reinforcing individual actions. Revising an assumption or learning when a correction applies may influence many future decisions, providing a route to generalization and potentially explaining the faster early progress relative to GRPO. Such higher-level supervision can also be more fine-grained than a trajectory-level reward: evidence grounds an explanation in observed behavior, while corrections identify which decisions should change and why. Correct and incorrect turns show a larger gap in likelihood-increase rates under RR than under GRPO, consistent with more selective credit assignment ( ). Mechanistically, predicting retrospection tokens can backpropagate gradients through attention to representations of the recorded actions and observations, updating shared model parameters even though the trajectory tokens themselves carry no prediction loss. This provides a pathway for explanation training to change subsequent actions without directly supervising them. Consistent with this, giving greater weight to retrospection tokens whose predictions attend more strongly to the user prompt containing the trajectory yields a higher observed solve rate than uniform weighting ( ). These findings motivate future work to trace how retrospection gradients reshape action-relevant representations and to test the role of this pathway in learning speed and generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设，RR 通过完善模型对经历的理解来改善行为，而不是直接强化单个动作。 当适用修正时，修订某个假设或学习过程可能会影响许多未来的决策，从而为泛化提供途径，并可能解释其早期进展为何比 GRPO 更快。 这种更高层级的监督也可以比轨迹级奖励更加精细：证据将解释锚定在观察到的行为上，而修正则明确哪些决策需要改变以及原因。 在 RR 下，正确与错误转向的可能性提升率之间的差距比在 GRPO 下更大，这与更具选择性的信用分配一致（）。 从机制上看，预测回顾标记可以通过注意力反向传播梯度至记录的动作和观察的表示，从而更新共享的模型参数，尽管轨迹标记本身并不携带预测损失。 这为解释训练提供了一种无需直接监督后续动作即可改变这些动作的途径。 与此一致的是，相较于均匀加权，赋予那些预测更强烈关注包含轨迹的用户提示的回顾标记更高权重，能带来更高的观察到的解决率（）。 这些发现激励了未来的研究，以追溯回顾梯度如何重塑与动作相关的表示，并检验该途径在学习速度和泛化中的作用。

paragraphs.en: Four retrospections per rollout give the highest observed test performance in this sweep, suggesting a useful balance between rollout diversity and retrospection diversity ( ). We compare 2, 4, and 8 independently sampled retrospections per rollout, using 128, 64, and 32 source rollouts, respectively, to keep 256 nominal retrospection targets per update. Fewer retrospections expose training to more source trajectories, whereas more retrospections provide more independently sampled interpretations of each trajectory. Neither extreme improves on the four-retrospection control here. See for details.
paragraphs.zh: 每次展开进行四次回顾，在本轮扫描中观察到的测试性能最高，这表明在展开多样性和回顾多样性之间存在一种有益的平衡（）。 我们比较了每次展开分别独立采样的 2、4 和 8 次回顾，并分别使用 128、64 和 32 个源展开，以确保每次更新有 256 个名义上的回顾目标。 较少的回顾会使训练暴露于更多的源轨迹中，而较多的回顾则能为每条轨迹提供更多独立采样的解释。 在此实验中，这两种极端情况都无法优于四次回顾的对照方案。详情请见。

paragraphs.en: The advantage over GRPO also holds for Qwen3.5-9B: after 20 updates, ROFT solves 58.8% of SWE-bench Verified versus 55.8% for GRPO ( ), using 1.93 versus 5.33 training hours. For Qwen3.5-9B, training performance begins to plateau around 20 updates. gives the training and evaluation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 与 GRPO 相比的优势在 Qwen3.5-9B 上同样成立：经过 20 次更新后，ROFT 解决了 SWE-bench Verified 中 58.8% 的问题，而 GRPO 为 55.8%（），且训练时间分别为 1.93 小时和 5.33 小时。 对于 Qwen3.5-9B，训练性能在大约 20 次更新后开始趋于平缓。提供了训练和评估方案。

paragraphs.en: Providing the final correctness verdict does not improve the observed SWE-bench Verified score in this comparison: after 20 updates, both the verdict-conditioned baseline and the no-verdict variant achieve 49.2% ( ). The no-verdict variant generates retrospections from the trajectory summary and final patch, without the final grader feedback. We hypothesize that environmental feedback already present in the trajectory, including observations from the agent’s own tests, provides sufficient context to generate useful retrospections without an explicit final correctness label. describes the training and evaluation protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 在此比较中，提供最终的正确性判定并未提升观察到的 SWE-bench Verified 分数：经过 20 次更新后，条件于判定的基线模型和无判定变体均达到了 49.2%（ ）。 无判定变体基于轨迹摘要和最终补丁生成回顾分析，但没有使用最终评分器的反馈。 我们推测，轨迹中已经存在的环境反馈——包括智能体自身测试的观察结果——足以提供足够的上下文来生成有用的回顾分析，而无需显式的最终正确性标签。描述了训练与评估协议。

paragraphs.en: Does it matter whether the model learns from its own current retrospections? compares three training regimes at 20 updates. Online RR, in which the evolving learner generates both attempts and retrospections, achieves 49.2%. Freezing the retrospection generator at the base model while continuing to refresh learner attempts yields 47.4%. Fully offline RR instead trains on a fixed corpus of base model attempts and retrospections and reaches 48.0%. The online procedure has the highest observed score, while fully offline training outperforms off-policy reflections. This ordering is consistent with a benefit from keeping the attempt and retrospection generators aligned, rather than refreshing attempts alone. See for details.
paragraphs.zh: 模型是否从自身的当前回顾中学习，这重要吗？该实验比较了三种训练机制在 20 次更新后的表现。 在线 RR 方法中，不断演进的学習者同时生成尝试和回顾，其准确率达到 49.2%。 将回顾生成器固定为基模型，同时继续更新学習者的尝试，则得到 47.4% 的准确率。 而完全离线的 RR 方法则是基于基模型的尝试和回顾的固定语料库进行训练，准确率达到 48.0%。 在线流程的观察得分最高，而完全离线的训练表现优于离策略的反思方法。 这种排序与保持尝试生成器和回顾生成器同步所带来的益处一致，而非仅更新尝试本身。详见相关研究。

paragraphs.en: Work leveraging retrospection and feedback broadly follows three routes: using interpretations to supervise task behavior, training on the feedback itself, or retaining it as context for later attempts. Retrospection reinforcement asks whether learning to explain one’s own experience can support learning to do : improving subsequent actions without directly training them or retaining explanations in context. Our procedure uses supervised fine-tuning on retrospections rather than reinforcement learning (RL). illustrates these three routes and distinguishes their conditioning context from their direct training targets. An extended comparison is provided in .

paragraphs.en: Context internalization transfers privileged information into the model’s weights so that it acts as if that information were still in its prompt. Training then makes that behavior available without the context. STaR illustrates a related supervised route: for a failed problem, it supplies the correct answer as a hint, generates a rationale, and retains the reasoning-and-answer sequence if the answer is correct. It then fine-tunes on that sequence without the hint ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) . On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD), RLTF-SD, and OPSD pursue a similar transfer using teacher predictions and, in the latter two, reward-based updates ( Ye et al., 2026b ; Song et al., 2026 ; Penaloza et al., 2026 ) . ERL combines this idea with reflection-guided retries, distilling successful revised behavior while also reinforcing attempts and reflections ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Simple self-distillation (SSD) removes the privileged context, fine-tuning on the model’s own samples at shifted temperatures ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . These methods share a common training target: actions ; our procedure instead makes the retrospection itself the training target.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文内化将特权信息转移到模型的权重中，使其表现得仿佛这些信息仍存在于提示中。 随后，训练使这种行为无需上下文即可实现。 STaR 展示了一种相关的监督方法：对于失败的问题，它会提供正确答案作为提示，生成推理依据，并在答案正确时保留推理与答案的序列。 然后，它在该序列上进行微调，但不再包含提示（Zelikman et al., 2022）。 On-Policy Context Distillation（OPCD）、RLTF-SD 和 OPSD 采用类似的方法进行知识迁移，分别利用教师模型的预测以及后两种方法中的基于奖励的更新（Ye et al., 2026b；Song et al., 2026；Penaloza et al., 2026）。 ERL 将这一思想与反思引导的重试相结合，在蒸馏成功修正的行为的同时，也强化尝试和反思过程（Shi et al., 2026）。 简单的自蒸馏（SSD）会移除特权上下文，并在模型自身样本上以调整后的温度进行微调（Zhang et al., 2026a）。 这些方法有一个共同的训练目标：动作；而我们的方法则将反思过程本身作为训练目标。

paragraphs.en: Predicting feedback offers a more direct route from an interpretation to the model’s weights. RLTF-FM adds feedback prediction to reward-based task training ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; Early Experience trains reflections and expert actions together ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Both therefore retain direct action supervision, although only RLTF uses RL. Critique Fine-Tuning (CFT) is closer to our procedure: training on teacher critiques can improve question answering without a separate answer-training objective ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Self-Critique Fine-Tuning (SCFT) uses reattempts to filter critiques ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . We study this same transfer in an online agent setting, using the actor’s own outcome-conditioned retrospections rather than externally taught or correctness-filtered critiques. We omit action-target losses to isolate retrospection reinforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 预测反馈为从解释到模型权重的转换提供了更直接的途径。 RLTF-FM 在基于奖励的任务训练中加入了反馈预测（Song et al., 2026）；Early Experience 则同时训练反思和专家动作（Zhang et al., 2025）。 因此，这两种方法都保留了直接的动作监督，但只有 RLTF 使用了强化学习。 Critique Fine-Tuning（CFT）与我们的流程更为接近：基于教师批评的训练可以在没有独立答案训练目标的情况下提升问答能力（Wang et al., 2025b）。 Self-Critique Fine-Tuning（SCFT）通过重新尝试来筛选批评（Wang et al., 2026）。 我们在在线智能体环境中研究了同样的迁移机制，其中使用的是演员自身基于结果的回顾性反思，而非外部教授或经过正确性筛选的批评。 我们省略了动作目标损失，以单独研究回顾性反思的强化过程。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, an interpretation can improve behavior by remaining available to the actor. Reflexion and Self-Refine pass feedback into later generations rather than update model weights ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Scattered Forest Search and Strategist similarly use feedback to search over code or textual strategies ( Light et al., 2025b ; Light et al., 2024a ) . Training the reflection generator does not remove this dependence: Retroformer trains a reflector, and RetroAct trains both actor and reflector, but their reflections still guide later trials ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . Our procedure removes that route: later attempts receive no carried-over reflection, so any benefit must transfer through the updated actor’s weights. summarizes these distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是，通过持续为执行者提供可用支持来改善行为。 Reflexion 和 Self-Refine 将反馈传递到后续生成阶段，而非更新模型权重（Shinn 等人，2023；Madaan 等人，2023）。 Scattered Forest Search 和 Strategist 同样利用反馈在代码或文本策略中进行搜索（Light 等人，2025b；Light 等人，2024a）。 训练反思生成器并不会消除这种依赖关系：Retroformer 会训练一个反思器，而 RetroAct 则会同时训练执行器和反思器，但它们的反思结果仍然会指导后续尝试（Yao 等人，2023；Feng 等人，2025）。 我们的方法切断了这一途径：后续尝试不会获得任何延续下来的反思结果，因此任何益处都必须通过更新后的执行器权重实现转移。

paragraphs.en: The cost of training and evaluating long-horizon agents limits the breadth of our experiments, which focus on software engineering with Qwen3.5-4B. A single 40-update GRPO training run costs $500, for example, at current market rates for GPUs, and a single evaluation run on SWE-bench Pro incurs $200 in GPU costs alone. We chose ROFT for its simplicity rather than optimality: even this minimal procedure can improve subsequent actions by training only on self-generated explanations. Our behavioral analyses support this transfer and motivate larger, controlled studies across models and domains to identify its causal mechanisms and guide more effective ways to generate and internalize useful explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 训练和评估长期规划智能体的成本限制了我们实验的广度，因此我们的研究聚焦于使用 Qwen3.5-4B 进行软件工程。 例如，在当前 GPU 市场价格下，一次包含 40 次更新的 GRPO 训练运行成本为 500 美元，而在 SWE-bench Pro 上进行单次评估运行的 GPU 成本就高达 200 美元。 我们选择 ROFT 是因为其简洁性而非最优性：即使这一极简流程也能通过仅基于自生成解释的训练来改进后续行动。 我们的行为分析支持这种迁移效果，并推动了跨模型和领域的大规模受控研究，以识别其因果机制，并为更有效地生成和内化有用解释提供指导。

sents.en: Our behavioral analyses support this transfer and motivate larger, controlled studies across models and domains to identify its causal mechanisms and guide more effective ways to generate and internalize useful explanations.

paragraphs.en: We explore whether an agent can improve its future actions by training only on self-generated retrospective explanations of its own experience. ROFT isolates this question with a minimal online procedure in which effects transfer to later attempts through the updated weights, and our findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do. This motivates algorithms that learn to assign credit and shape behavior through language, rather than encoding every desired change in a scalar reward. This direction is especially relevant for long-horizon agents, where sparse outcomes provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions mattered. Grounding retrospections in observations could also broaden learning beyond curated tasks with human-crafted verifiers, making ordinary interaction a source of supervision. The next challenge is to learn which interpretations deserve to be internalized, so that agents improve from evidence rather than reinforce plausible but mistaken explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨了一个智能体是否仅通过训练自己生成的、对其自身经验的回顾性解释，就能改进其未来的行动。 ROFT 采用一种极简的在线流程来聚焦这一问题：更新后的权重会将效果传递到后续尝试中，而我们的研究结果表明，学习解释也能提升学习执行的能力。 这启发我们设计算法，通过语言来分配功劳和塑造行为，而不是将每个期望的改变都编码到一个标量奖励中。 这一方向对于长期规划的智能体尤为重要，因为稀疏的结果几乎无法提供关于哪些中间决策至关重要的指导。 将回顾性解释与观察结果相绑定，也可能使学习超越人类设计的验证器所覆盖的精选任务，让普通的互动成为监督的来源。 下一个挑战是学会识别哪些解释值得内化，从而让智能体能够从证据中改进自身，而不是强化看似合理但错误的解释。

paragraphs.en: This work studies software-engineering agents on existing benchmarks using model-generated attempts and retrospections, rather than deploying them to end users. Improved coding agents can support software maintenance, but can also generate insecure or incorrect code and lower barriers to misuse. Benchmark test success does not establish safety, security, or reliability outside the evaluated tasks. Self-generated retrospections can reinforce mistaken explanations or biased assumptions and should not be treated as faithful accounts of a model’s internal reasoning. Deployment would require independent validation, restricted tool permissions, isolated execution environments, and human oversight appropriate to the application. Reuse or redistribution of the underlying models, benchmark data, repository code, and derived artifacts remains subject to their respective licenses and terms; public availability does not by itself remove privacy or intellectual-property concerns. Training and evaluation also incur computational and environmental costs. Our reported efficiency improvements are specific to the measured experimental budgets, not estimates of lifecycle environmental impact.

paragraphs.en: Retrospection reinforcement (RR) studies whether learning to explain past experience can improve future actions. Our procedure collects the agent’s own attempts and available feedback, generates retrospections with the same model, and applies next-token cross-entropy only to the retrospective continuations. Subsequent attempts use updated weights without the earlier retrospections in context. The relevant distinction from prior work is therefore not the presence of reflective language, but its role in learning: feedback can supervise task behavior, become a prediction target itself, or remain available as inference-time context. Following the main text, we organize the comparison around these three routes, illustrated in .
paragraphs.zh: 回顾强化学习（RR）研究的是，学习解释过往经历是否能够改善未来的行动。 我们的方法会收集智能体自身的尝试和可用的反馈，用同一模型生成回顾性内容，并且仅对回顾性续写部分应用下一个词元的交叉熵损失。 后续的尝试会使用更新后的权重，而不再将之前的回顾性内容纳入上下文。 因此，与以往研究的关键区别并不在于是否存在反思性语言，而在于它在学习中的作用：反馈可以监督任务行为，也可以成为预测目标本身，或者在推理时作为上下文保留下来。 按照正文的论述，我们将围绕这三种路径展开比较，如图中所示。

sents.en: Retrospection reinforcement (RR) studies whether learning to explain past experience can improve future actions.
sents.zh: 回顾强化学习（RR）研究的是，学习解释过往经历是否能够改善未来的行动。

sents.en: Following the main text, we organize the comparison around these three routes, illustrated in .
sents.zh: 按照正文的论述，我们将围绕这三种路径展开比较，如图中所示。

paragraphs.en: An interpretation can improve a policy by helping construct better task outputs for training. Imitation learning from language feedback (ILF) generates feedback-conditioned revisions and trains the task model on selected revisions rather than on the feedback itself ( Scheurer et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . STaR similarly fine-tunes on generated reasoning-and-answer sequences that yield correct answers ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) . Failed problems can be revisited by supplying the correct answer as a hint and generating a rationalization, so STaR does not simply discard unsuccessful experience. In both cases, however, the retained target practices a successful response. RR instead trains an account of the completed attempt, without requiring a successful replacement trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 一种解释可以通过帮助构建更优的任务输出用于训练，从而改进策略。 基于语言反馈的模仿学习（ILF）会生成受反馈条件约束的修订版本，并在选定的修订版本上进行任务模型训练，而非直接对反馈本身进行训练（Scheurer 等，2023；Chen 等，2023）。 STaR 同样通过针对能产生正确答案的推理与回答序列进行微调（Zelikman 等，2022）。 对于失败的问题，可以通过提供正确答案作为提示并生成合理解释来重新尝试，因此 STaR 并不会简单地丢弃未成功的经验。 然而在这两种情况下，保留的目标都是练习一种成功的响应方式。 相比之下，RR 会训练对已完成尝试的说明，而无需要求存在一个成功的替代轨迹。

sents.en: An interpretation can improve a policy by helping construct better task outputs for training.
sents.zh: 一种解释可以通过帮助构建更优的任务输出用于训练，从而改进策略。

paragraphs.en: Context distillation makes the transfer from guidance to behavior explicit: a teacher receives information that the deployed student will not receive, and training aligns the student’s predictions with the teacher’s ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Snell et al., 2022 ) . On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) applies this principle along student-generated responses ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . Its experiential variant extracts reusable lessons from trajectories and supplies them to the teacher during distillation. Online Experiential Learning (OEL) repeats experience collection, extraction, and consolidation ( Ye et al., 2026a ) . These methods already pursue online learning from experience without retaining the lessons at deployment. Their direct targets are nevertheless task-response distributions , whereas RR predicts the retrospective explanation .
paragraphs.zh: 上下文蒸馏使从引导到行为的转换变得明确：教师接收了部署后的学生无法接收的信息，而训练过程则使学生的预测与教师的预测保持一致（Askell et al., 2021；Snell et al., 2022）。 在线策略上下文蒸馏（OPCD）沿学生生成的响应应用了这一原则（Ye et al., 2026b）。 其经验变体从轨迹中提取可重用的经验教训，并在蒸馏过程中将其提供给教师。 在线经验学习（OEL）重复进行经验收集、提取和整合（Ye et al., 2026a）。 这些方法已经实现了基于经验的在线学习，但在部署时并未保留这些经验教训。 然而，它们直接针对的是任务响应分布，而 RR 则预测回顾性解释。

sents.zh: 在线经验学习（OEL）重复进行经验收集、提取和整合（Ye et al., 2026a）。

sents.zh: 这些方法已经实现了基于经验的在线学习，但在部署时并未保留这些经验教训。

sents.en: Their direct targets are nevertheless task-response distributions , whereas RR predicts the retrospective explanation .
sents.zh: 然而，它们直接针对的是任务响应分布，而 RR 则预测回顾性解释。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-conditioned self-distillation provides closely related comparisons. Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) uses an informed self-teacher to supervise response-token distributions; rich feedback can supply this signal without a complete corrected response ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (RESD) adds failure diagnoses and accumulated guidance to the teacher’s context ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while Procedural Memory Distillation (PMD) internalizes experience through memory-conditioned behavioral distillation ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . HERO makes the target distinction particularly clear: hindsight reflections condition a teacher that supervises the original assistant-action tokens, not the reflections ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Thus self-generated lessons, learning from failure, and memory-free deployment do not by themselves distinguish RR. The difference is whether the lesson informs an action-training signal or is itself the supervised continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于反馈的自我蒸馏提供了密切相关的对比。 自我蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）利用一个具备信息的自我教师来监督响应词元分布；丰富的反馈无需完整的正确响应即可提供这种信号（Hübotter 等，2026）。 反思增强型自我蒸馏（RESD）将失败诊断和累积的指导信息加入教师的上下文（Zhang 等，2026b），而程序记忆蒸馏（PMD）则通过受记忆条件约束的行为蒸馏将经验内化（Liu 等，2026b）。 HERO 使这一关键区别尤为清晰：事后反思用于条件化一个教师，该教师监督的是原始的助手动作词元，而非反思本身（Liu 等，2026a）。 因此，自我生成的教训、从失败中学习以及无记忆部署本身并不能区分 RR。 区别在于，这种教训是用于指导动作训练的信号，还是其自身就是被监督的延续。

sents.en: Feedback-conditioned self-distillation provides closely related comparisons.
sents.zh: 基于反馈的自我蒸馏提供了密切相关的对比。

sents.en: Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (RESD) adds failure diagnoses and accumulated guidance to the teacher’s context ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while Procedural Memory Distillation (PMD) internalizes experience through memory-conditioned behavioral distillation ( Liu et al., 2026b ) .

sents.zh: 因此，自我生成的教训、从失败中学习以及无记忆部署本身并不能区分 RR。

sents.en: The difference is whether the lesson informs an action-training signal or is itself the supervised continuation.
sents.zh: 区别在于，这种教训是用于指导动作训练的信号，还是其自身就是被监督的延续。

paragraphs.en: Experiential Reinforcement Learning (ERL) combines reflection-guided retries with reward-based updates to attempts and reflections ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . It also internalizes positive-reward revisions under the original task prompt, enabling deployment without the reflection. RLTF’s Self-Distillation variant likewise transfers feedback-guided second-turn behavior to the original-prompt policy alongside multi-turn RL ( Song et al., 2026 ) . Privileged-information distillation combines reward and distribution-alignment objectives using training-only guidance ( Penaloza et al., 2026 ) . These methods directly optimize task behavior; our procedure omits both reward-driven action updates and revised-response imitation. This is a distinction between training targets, not between methods with and without RL: supervised imitation also trains behavior, and RL can train reflections.
paragraphs.zh: 体验式强化学习（ERL）将反思引导的重试与基于奖励的对尝试和反思的更新相结合（Shi 等人，2026）。 它还在原始任务提示下内化正向奖励的修订，从而无需反思即可部署。 RLTF 的自我蒸馏变体同样将反馈引导的第二轮行为转移至原始提示策略中，并结合多轮强化学习（Song 等人，2026）。 特权信息蒸馏结合奖励和分布对齐目标，并使用仅用于训练的指导方法（Penaloza 等人，2026）。 这些方法直接优化任务行为；而我们的流程则省略了奖励驱动的动作更新和修订后响应的模仿。 这是训练目标之间的区别，而非有强化学习和无强化学习的方法之间的区别：监督模仿同样会训练行为，而强化学习也可以训练反思。

sents.zh: 体验式强化学习（ERL）将反思引导的重试与基于奖励的对尝试和反思的更新相结合（Shi 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Training on evaluative language offers a more direct precedent for RR. Early dialogue systems learn to predict a teacher’s response after an attempted answer, with shared parameters allowing feedback prediction to improve answering without the feedback-prediction component at evaluation ( Weston, 2016 ; Li et al., 2016 ) . These studies establish that transfer from post-answer language to task performance predates current reflection methods. Their supervision is externally supplied, rather than generated by an agent interpreting its own interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 在评价性语言上进行训练为 RR 提供了更直接的先例。 早期的对话系统会在学习预测教师对尝试性回答的回应，共享参数使得反馈预测能够提升回答能力，而无需在评估时包含反馈预测组件（Weston, 2016；Li et al., 2016）。 这些研究表明，从回答后语言向任务表现的知识迁移早于当前的反思方法。 它们的监督来自外部提供，而非由智能体通过解释自身交互生成。

sents.en: Training on evaluative language offers a more direct precedent for RR.
sents.zh: 在评价性语言上进行训练为 RR 提供了更直接的先例。

sents.en: Early dialogue systems learn to predict a teacher’s response after an attempted answer, with shared parameters allowing feedback prediction to improve answering without the feedback-prediction component at evaluation ( Weston, 2016 ; Li et al., 2016 ) .
sents.zh: 早期的对话系统会在学习预测教师对尝试性回答的回应，共享参数使得反馈预测能够提升回答能力，而无需在评估时包含反馈预测组件（Weston, 2016；Li et al., 2016）。

sents.zh: 这些研究表明，从回答后语言向任务表现的知识迁移早于当前的反思方法。

sents.en: Their supervision is externally supplied, rather than generated by an agent interpreting its own interaction.
sents.zh: 它们的监督来自外部提供，而非由智能体通过解释自身交互生成。

paragraphs.en: RLTF’s Feedback Modeling variant applies cross-entropy to feedback tokens, treating the sampled answer as fixed, alongside reward-based task training ( Song et al., 2026 ) . It is therefore a close precedent for our loss-target choice, distinct from RLTF’s Self-Distillation variant discussed above. Agent Learning via Early Experience also uses observed transitions as richer learning material than scalar rewards: its self-reflection route jointly predicts a reflection and an expert action ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Both retain direct task training. RR removes that component to isolate transfer from retrospection prediction to subsequent actions.
paragraphs.zh: RLTF 的反馈建模变体将交叉熵应用于反馈标记，同时将采样得到的答案视为固定不变，并辅以基于奖励的任务训练（Song 等人，2026）。 因此，它与我们所选择的损失目标密切相关，但不同于上文讨论的 RLTF 自我蒸馏变体。 通过早期经验进行智能体学习也利用观察到的状态转移作为比标量奖励更丰富的学习材料：其自我反思路径会同时预测反思结果和专家动作（Zhang 等人，2025）。 这两种方法都保留了直接的任务训练环节。 RR 移除了这一部分，以便将迁移过程从回顾性预测中分离出来，仅关注后续动作。

paragraphs.en: Critique Fine-Tuning (CFT) is closer still. It supervises critiques conditioned on questions and candidate solutions, then evaluates the model’s ability to answer questions directly ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Its main targets come from an external critique teacher, and its experiments also consider candidate answers generated by the student. CFT thus already demonstrates the central possibility that learning to evaluate an answer can improve generation without a separate answer-training objective. Our study extends this question to online agent experience, using retrospections authored by the continually updated actor rather than a fixed collection of externally taught critiques.
paragraphs.zh: 批判性微调（CFT）更进一步。 它基于问题和候选解决方案来监督批判过程，然后评估模型直接回答问题能力（Wang 等人，2025b）。 其主要目标来自外部的批判教师，其实验也考虑了学生生成的候选答案。 因此，CFT 已经证明了这样一个核心可能性：学习评估答案能够提升生成能力，而无需单独的答案训练目标。 我们的研究将这一问题扩展到在线智能体经验中，使用持续更新的执行者撰写的回顾性分析，而非固定集合的外部批判内容。

sents.en: Critique Fine-Tuning (CFT) is closer still.
sents.zh: 批判性微调（CFT）更进一步。

paragraphs.en: Self-Critique Fine-Tuning (SCFT) further narrows this distinction ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . The same model generates solutions and critiques, and ground-truth-based filtering selects acceptable critiques for supervised fine-tuning. Standalone SCFT supports direct answering without a supplied critique; its additional RLERR stage is a separate RL component. Neither self-generated critique targets nor critique-to-answer transfer is therefore unique to RR. Moreover, SCFT targets can include corrected derivations and final answers: masking the input solution does not make the supervised content solution-free. Our procedure trains on self-generated post-attempt accounts, without requiring a successful revised solution as a training target. These accounts may summarize events, track changes in beliefs, or discuss evidence and corrective actions. The distinction concerns the training task, not an absence of actionable information.
paragraphs.zh: 自我批评微调（SCFT）进一步缩小了这一区别（Wang 等人，2026）。 同一模型会生成解决方案和批评意见，而基于真实答案的过滤机制则会挑选出可接受的批评意见用于监督微调。 独立的 SCFT 支持在无需提供批评意见的情况下直接回答问题；其额外的 RLERR 阶段是一个独立的强化学习组件。 因此，既非自我生成的批评目标，也非从批评到答案的迁移，都不是 RR 所独有的。 此外，SCFT 的目标可以包括修正后的推导过程和最终答案：对输入解决方案进行掩码并不会使监督内容变得没有解决方案。 我们的方法基于自我生成的尝试后说明进行训练，而无需将成功修订后的解决方案作为训练目标。 这些说明可能总结事件、追踪信念的变化，或讨论证据和纠正措施。 这种区别涉及的是训练任务，而非缺乏可操作的信息。

paragraphs.en: The remaining differences concern the learning setting and evidence. RR refreshes attempts and retrospective targets as the policy changes, conditions generation on the observed trajectory and available outcome feedback, and admits both successful and unsuccessful attempts. It does not independently verify the explanation’s correctness. A reliable test verdict can ground a retrospection without validating its causal claims, so omitting critique-quality filtering is a limitation as well as a simplification. The contribution is to isolate this online, self-authored, retrospection-only configuration, not to introduce critique prediction as a new objective.
paragraphs.zh: 其余差异涉及学习设置和证据。 RR 会随着策略的变化而更新尝试和回顾性目标，将生成条件于观察到的轨迹和可用的结果反馈，并允许成功和失败的尝试。 它不会独立验证解释的正确性。 可靠的测试判定可以为回顾提供依据，而无需验证其因果主张，因此省略批判质量过滤既是局限性，也是一种简化。 本研究的贡献在于隔离这种在线、自我生成且仅包含回顾的配置，而非将批判预测作为新的目标引入。

paragraphs.en: Reflexion stores verbal self-reflections in episodic memory and supplies them to subsequent attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Self-Refine uses feedback from the same model to revise an output without additional weight training ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . ExpeL extracts reusable insights and retrieves experience for future tasks ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) . These methods show that reflection can support both local correction and cross-task improvement through an external memory. The contrast with RR is not whether learning persists across tasks, but whether the actor must receive the retained text. Scattered Forest Search and Strategist similarly use feedback to guide search over code or textual strategies rather than train the actor on retrospective continuations ( Light et al., 2025b ; Light et al., 2024a ) . Related multi-agent work includes AvalonBench, which evaluates LLMs in the social-deduction game Avalon ( Light et al., 2023 ) , and PIANIST, which generates world models with LLMs for Monte Carlo tree search ( Light et al., 2024b ) .
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion 将语言形式的自我反思存储于情景记忆中，并在后续尝试中提供这些内容（Shinn 等，2023）。 Self-Refine 利用同一模型提供的反馈来修订输出，而无需额外的权重训练（Madaan 等，2023）。 ExpeL 提取可重复使用的洞见，并为未来任务检索经验（Zhao 等，2023）。 这些方法表明，通过外部记忆，反思既能支持局部修正，也能促进跨任务的改进。 与 RR 的对比并不在于学习是否能在不同任务间持续，而在于执行者是否必须接收保留下来的文本。 Scattered Forest Search 和 Strategist 同样利用反馈来指导代码或文本策略的搜索，而非通过回顾性续写来训练执行者（Light 等，2025b；Light 等，2024a）。 相关的多智能体研究包括 AvalonBench，该研究在社交推理游戏 Avalon 中评估大型语言模型（Light 等，2023）；以及 PIANIST，该研究使用大型语言模型生成世界模型以进行蒙特卡洛树搜索（Light 等，2024b）。

paragraphs.en: Learning the reflection generator does not necessarily remove this inference-time dependence. Retroformer trains a reflector to produce feedback that helps a frozen actor; RetroAct jointly trains planning and reflection, including a shared-model variant ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . Their reflections still guide later trials. The relevant distinction is consequently not separate versus shared weights, but the pathway through which a reflection changes behavior. RR omits carried-over retrospections and an added reflection step on subsequent tasks, testing whether the effect transfers through the actor’s updated parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 学习反射生成器并不一定能消除这种推理时的依赖关系。 Retroformer 训练一个反射器来产生反馈，以辅助一个冻结的演员；RetroAct 则联合训练规划与反射，包括一种共享模型变体（Yao et al., 2023 ; Feng et al., 2025）。 它们的反射仍然会指导后续的实验。 因此，相关的区别并非权重是独立的还是共享的，而是反射通过何种路径改变行为。 RR 省略了延续下来的回顾以及对后续任务的额外反射步骤，以测试这种效应是否通过演员的更新参数传递。

sents.en: Learning the reflection generator does not necessarily remove this inference-time dependence.
sents.zh: 学习反射生成器并不一定能消除这种推理时的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Beyond reflection, inference-time methods improve solution generation by changing how computation is allocated. DISC adaptively decomposes solution traces and prioritizes difficult steps ( Light et al., 2025a ) , while diversified sampling uses prompt perturbations to broaden candidate exploration ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . These approaches modify inference-time search and selection rather than train an actor to predict retrospective explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 除了反思之外，推理时的方法通过改变计算资源的分配方式来改进解决方案的生成。 DISC 能够自适应地分解解决方案轨迹并优先处理困难步骤（Light 等人，2025a），而多样化采样则利用提示扰动来扩大候选解的探索范围（Wang 等人，2025a）。 这些方法修改的是推理时的搜索与选择过程，而不是训练一个智能体来预测事后解释。

sents.en: Beyond reflection, inference-time methods improve solution generation by changing how computation is allocated.
sents.zh: 除了反思之外，推理时的方法通过改变计算资源的分配方式来改进解决方案的生成。

sents.en: DISC adaptively decomposes solution traces and prioritizes difficult steps ( Light et al., 2025a ) , while diversified sampling uses prompt perturbations to broaden candidate exploration ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: DISC 能够自适应地分解解决方案轨迹并优先处理困难步骤（Light 等人，2025a），而多样化采样则利用提示扰动来扩大候选解的探索范围（Wang 等人，2025a）。

sents.en: These approaches modify inference-time search and selection rather than train an actor to predict retrospective explanations.

paragraphs.en: Retrospection-only training isolates learning to explain, evaluated by doing . Unlike reward-based updates such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , its loss does not weight attempted actions by their outcomes. RLVR often relies on careful curation of problems within the model’s learning zone, either manually or through automated curricula such as Actor-Curator ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . By contrast, retrospective targets remain available even when all sampled attempts fail and a GRPO group has no relative outcome advantage. These properties motivate future work on generating useful explanations from failed attempts and identifying the mechanisms and conditions that make transfer through shared parameters reliable. The relevant evidence is improved behavior on independent attempts without retained retrospections, not explanation fluency alone. The closest prior work motivates comparisons with critique training, feedback-conditioned action distillation, and retained textual memory, rather than a general claim of superiority over those routes.
paragraphs.zh: 仅基于回顾的训练将学习局限于解释，其效果通过执行操作进行评估。 与 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）等基于奖励的更新方法不同，其损失函数不会根据尝试动作的结果对其进行加权。 RLVR 通常依赖对模型学习区域内问题的精心筛选，无论是手动完成，还是通过 Actor-Curator（Gu 等人，2026）等自动化课程实现。 相比之下，即使所有采样尝试均失败且 GRPO 群体没有任何相对结果优势时，回顾性目标仍然可用。 这些特性为未来工作提供了动力，即从失败的尝试中生成有用的解释，并识别出通过共享参数实现可靠迁移的机制与条件。 相关证据体现在独立尝试中的行为改善上，而非仅凭解释的流畅性。 最接近的前期研究支持将其与批判训练、反馈条件化的动作蒸馏以及保留的文本记忆进行比较，而非笼统地声称优于这些方法。

sents.en: Retrospection-only training isolates learning to explain, evaluated by doing .
sents.zh: 仅基于回顾的训练将学习局限于解释，其效果通过执行操作进行评估。

sents.en: Unlike reward-based updates such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , its loss does not weight attempted actions by their outcomes.
sents.zh: 与 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）等基于奖励的更新方法不同，其损失函数不会根据尝试动作的结果对其进行加权。

sents.en: RLVR often relies on careful curation of problems within the model’s learning zone, either manually or through automated curricula such as Actor-Curator ( Gu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: RLVR 通常依赖对模型学习区域内问题的精心筛选，无论是手动完成，还是通过 Actor-Curator（Gu 等人，2026）等自动化课程实现。

sents.en: By contrast, retrospective targets remain available even when all sampled attempts fail and a GRPO group has no relative outcome advantage.
sents.zh: 相比之下，即使所有采样尝试均失败且 GRPO 群体没有任何相对结果优势时，回顾性目标仍然可用。

sents.en: These properties motivate future work on generating useful explanations from failed attempts and identifying the mechanisms and conditions that make transfer through shared parameters reliable.
sents.zh: 这些特性为未来工作提供了动力，即从失败的尝试中生成有用的解释，并识别出通过共享参数实现可靠迁移的机制与条件。

sents.en: The relevant evidence is improved behavior on independent attempts without retained retrospections, not explanation fluency alone.
sents.zh: 相关证据体现在独立尝试中的行为改善上，而非仅凭解释的流畅性。

sents.en: The closest prior work motivates comparisons with critique training, feedback-conditioned action distillation, and retained textual memory, rather than a general claim of superiority over those routes.
sents.zh: 最接近的前期研究支持将其与批判训练、反馈条件化的动作蒸馏以及保留的文本记忆进行比较，而非笼统地声称优于这些方法。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the Qwen3.5-4B online training procedure for ROFT. Training budgets and experiment-specific changes are reported in , , and .
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了 Qwen3.5-4B 针对 ROFT 的在线训练流程。 训练预算和实验特定的变更在 、 和 中有详细说明。

sents.en: This section describes the Qwen3.5-4B online training procedure for ROFT.
sents.zh: 本节介绍了 Qwen3.5-4B 针对 ROFT 的在线训练流程。

sents.en: Training budgets and experiment-specific changes are reported in , , and .
sents.zh: 训练预算和实验特定的变更在 、 和 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: We initialize the policy from Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and train on SWE-rebench-767, a fixed collection of 767 software-engineering tasks. Each task is executed in a repository-specific container. The agent can read, write, and edit files, search the repository, and execute shell commands. Its system instruction is:
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Qwen3.5-4B（Qwen Team，2026）初始化策略，并在 SWE-rebench-767 上进行训练，这是一个包含 767 项软件工程任务的固定集合。 每个任务都在一个特定于该代码库的容器中执行。 智能体可以读取、写入和编辑文件，搜索代码库，以及执行 shell 命令。 其系统指令是：

sents.en: We initialize the policy from Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and train on SWE-rebench-767, a fixed collection of 767 software-engineering tasks.
sents.zh: 我们从 Qwen3.5-4B（Qwen Team，2026）初始化策略，并在 SWE-rebench-767 上进行训练，这是一个包含 767 项软件工程任务的固定集合。

sents.en: Each task is executed in a repository-specific container.
sents.zh: 每个任务都在一个特定于该代码库的容器中执行。

sents.en: The agent can read, write, and edit files, search the repository, and execute shell commands.
sents.zh: 智能体可以读取、写入和编辑文件，搜索代码库，以及执行 shell 命令。

sents.en: Its system instruction is:
sents.zh: 其系统指令是：

paragraphs.en: You are a software-engineering agent working in a checked-out repository. Use the available tools to inspect files, make focused edits, and run commands. Solve the task, validate when practical, then give a brief final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 你是一个在已检出仓库中工作的软件工程智能体。 使用可用工具检查文件、进行针对性编辑并运行命令。 完成任务，在可行的情况下进行验证，然后给出简要的最终答案。

sents.en: You are a software-engineering agent working in a checked-out repository.
sents.zh: 你是一个在已检出仓库中工作的软件工程智能体。

sents.en: Use the available tools to inspect files, make focused edits, and run commands.
sents.zh: 使用可用工具检查文件、进行针对性编辑并运行命令。

sents.en: Solve the task, validate when practical, then give a brief final answer.
sents.zh: 完成任务，在可行的情况下进行验证，然后给出简要的最终答案。

paragraphs.en: The environment supplies the task description and evaluates the resulting patch. We allow at most 100 agent turns, 8,192 generated tokens per turn, and a context window of 131,072 tokens. Context compaction is disabled. The solver samples at temperature 1.0 with top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 .
paragraphs.zh: 环境提供任务描述，并对生成的补丁进行评估。 我们最多允许智能体执行 100 轮操作，每轮生成 8,192 个标记，上下文窗口大小为 131,072 个标记。 上下文压缩已禁用。 求解器以温度 1.0 和 top-p = 1.0 进行采样。

sents.en: The environment supplies the task description and evaluates the resulting patch.
sents.zh: 环境提供任务描述，并对生成的补丁进行评估。

sents.en: We allow at most 100 agent turns, 8,192 generated tokens per turn, and a context window of 131,072 tokens.
sents.zh: 我们最多允许智能体执行 100 轮操作，每轮生成 8,192 个标记，上下文窗口大小为 131,072 个标记。

sents.en: Context compaction is disabled.
sents.zh: 上下文压缩已禁用。

sents.en: The solver samples at temperature 1.0 with top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 .
sents.zh: 求解器以温度 1.0 和 top-p = 1.0 进行采样。

paragraphs.en: Task order is shuffled and the dataset is traversed cyclically, with reshuffling at each epoch. Because generation and environment execution are asynchronous, completion order also influences batch composition.
paragraphs.zh: 任务顺序被打乱，数据集以循环方式遍历，每个周期都会重新打乱。 由于生成和环境执行是异步的，完成顺序也会影响批次的构成。

sents.en: Task order is shuffled and the dataset is traversed cyclically, with reshuffling at each epoch.
sents.zh: 任务顺序被打乱，数据集以循环方式遍历，每个周期都会重新打乱。

sents.en: Because generation and environment execution are asynchronous, completion order also influences batch composition.
sents.zh: 由于生成和环境执行是异步的，完成顺序也会影响批次的构成。

paragraphs.en: After each attempted solution, the same policy generates four independent retrospections, conditioned on the same task, trajectory summary, patch, and test feedback. The default prompt used in these experiments requests a short paragraph without lists that identifies a consequential assumption or decision, relates it to supporting or contradicting evidence, gives a correction when appropriate, and states concrete triggers for applying the lesson. It explicitly distinguishes the correctness of individual decisions from the overall verdict and asks the model to acknowledge insufficient evidence. The complete prompt and two generated examples are provided in .
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试解决方案后，同一策略都会生成四个独立的回顾分析，其条件基于相同的任务、轨迹摘要、补丁和测试反馈。 这些实验中使用的默认提示要求生成一段简短的段落（不含列表），其中需指出一个具有影响的关键假设或决策，将其与支持或反驳的证据联系起来，在适当时给出修正，并明确说明应用该经验教训的具体触发因素。 该提示明确区分了单个决策的正确性与整体判断，并要求模型承认证据不足的情况。 完整的提示以及两个生成的示例已提供在文件中。

sents.en: After each attempted solution, the same policy generates four independent retrospections, conditioned on the same task, trajectory summary, patch, and test feedback.
sents.zh: 每次尝试解决方案后，同一策略都会生成四个独立的回顾分析，其条件基于相同的任务、轨迹摘要、补丁和测试反馈。

sents.en: The default prompt used in these experiments requests a short paragraph without lists that identifies a consequential assumption or decision, relates it to supporting or contradicting evidence, gives a correction when appropriate, and states concrete triggers for applying the lesson.
sents.zh: 这些实验中使用的默认提示要求生成一段简短的段落（不含列表），其中需指出一个具有影响的关键假设或决策，将其与支持或反驳的证据联系起来，在适当时给出修正，并明确说明应用该经验教训的具体触发因素。

sents.en: It explicitly distinguishes the correctness of individual decisions from the overall verdict and asks the model to acknowledge insufficient evidence.
sents.zh: 该提示明确区分了单个决策的正确性与整体判断，并要求模型承认证据不足的情况。

sents.en: The complete prompt and two generated examples are provided in .
sents.zh: 完整的提示以及两个生成的示例已提供在文件中。

paragraphs.en: We sample retrospections at temperature 0.9 with top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 and an 8,192-token output limit. The short-paragraph instruction specifies this prompt’s requested answer format, not the general form of retrospection, and does not exclude the model’s preceding thinking from supervision. Both failed and successful attempts contribute targets, without reward weighting or a semantic-quality filter.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以温度 0.9、top-p = 1.0（p=1.0）以及 8,192 个标记的输出限制来采样回顾。 短段落指令指定了此提示所要求的回答格式，而非回顾的一般形式，并且并未将模型此前的思考过程排除在监督之外。 失败和成功的尝试都会贡献目标，且没有奖励加权或语义质量过滤。

sents.en: We sample retrospections at temperature 0.9 with top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 and an 8,192-token output limit.
sents.zh: 我们以温度 0.9、top-p = 1.0（p=1.0）以及 8,192 个标记的输出限制来采样回顾。

sents.en: The short-paragraph instruction specifies this prompt’s requested answer format, not the general form of retrospection, and does not exclude the model’s preceding thinking from supervision.
sents.zh: 短段落指令指定了此提示所要求的回答格式，而非回顾的一般形式，并且并未将模型此前的思考过程排除在监督之外。

sents.en: Both failed and successful attempts contribute targets, without reward weighting or a semantic-quality filter.
sents.zh: 失败和成功的尝试都会贡献目标，且没有奖励加权或语义质量过滤。

paragraphs.en: The prompt reports the raw test outcome separately from reward adjustments and the reason for termination. An attempt that passes its tests but exhausts the turn budget therefore retains a passing test verdict; budget exhaustion is reported separately. If raw test feedback is unavailable, the verdict is marked unknown rather than inferred from the shaped reward.
paragraphs.zh: 提示会单独报告原始测试结果、奖励调整以及终止原因。 因此，通过测试但用尽回合预算的尝试仍保留“测试通过”的判断；预算耗尽的情况会被单独报告。 如果无法获取原始测试反馈，则判断结果会被标记为未知，而不是根据调整后的奖励进行推断。

sents.en: The prompt reports the raw test outcome separately from reward adjustments and the reason for termination.
sents.zh: 提示会单独报告原始测试结果、奖励调整以及终止原因。

sents.en: An attempt that passes its tests but exhausts the turn budget therefore retains a passing test verdict; budget exhaustion is reported separately.
sents.zh: 因此，通过测试但用尽回合预算的尝试仍保留“测试通过”的判断；预算耗尽的情况会被单独报告。

sents.en: If raw test feedback is unavailable, the verdict is marked unknown rather than inferred from the shaped reward.
sents.zh: 如果无法获取原始测试反馈，则判断结果会被标记为未知，而不是根据调整后的奖励进行推断。

paragraphs.en: The no-verdict ablation removes the entire post-attempt verdict and test-feedback block from the retrospection prompt, rather than only the pass/fail label. Observations recorded during the task attempt remain available, including any test output already present in that trajectory. The faster-retrospection experiment instead retains the verdict and uses it to choose the instruction ( ).
paragraphs.zh: “无判定”消融方法从回顾提示中移除了整个尝试后的判定与测试反馈模块，而不仅仅是通过/失败标签。 任务尝试期间记录的观察结果仍然可用，包括该轨迹中已存在的任何测试输出。 在“更快回顾”实验中，则保留判定，并利用其来选择指令（ ）。

sents.en: The no-verdict ablation removes the entire post-attempt verdict and test-feedback block from the retrospection prompt, rather than only the pass/fail label.
sents.zh: “无判定”消融方法从回顾提示中移除了整个尝试后的判定与测试反馈模块，而不仅仅是通过/失败标签。

sents.en: Observations recorded during the task attempt remain available, including any test output already present in that trajectory.
sents.zh: 任务尝试期间记录的观察结果仍然可用，包括该轨迹中已存在的任何测试输出。

sents.en: The faster-retrospection experiment instead retains the verdict and uses it to choose the instruction ( ).
sents.zh: 在“更快回顾”实验中，则保留判定，并利用其来选择指令（ ）。

paragraphs.en: The retrospective context is constructed from a bounded rendering of the interaction, rather than the complete solver context. lists the character budgets. For fields exceeding a budget, we retain the first two-thirds and last one-third, separated by a truncation marker. Thought, action, and observation fields are shortened independently before the trajectory-level budget is applied. The full prompt and target must also fit the 131,072-token training sequence limit.
paragraphs.zh: 回顾性上下文是从交互的有限呈现中构建的，而非完整的求解器上下文。此处列出了各角色的预算额度。 对于超出预算的字段，我们保留前三分之二和后三分之一，并以截断标记分隔。 在应用轨迹级预算之前，思考、行动和观察字段会分别进行缩短处理。 完整提示和目标也必须符合 131,072 个词符的训练序列限制。

sents.en: The retrospective context is constructed from a bounded rendering of the interaction, rather than the complete solver context. lists the character budgets.
sents.zh: 回顾性上下文是从交互的有限呈现中构建的，而非完整的求解器上下文。此处列出了各角色的预算额度。

sents.en: For fields exceeding a budget, we retain the first two-thirds and last one-third, separated by a truncation marker.
sents.zh: 对于超出预算的字段，我们保留前三分之二和后三分之一，并以截断标记分隔。

sents.en: Thought, action, and observation fields are shortened independently before the trajectory-level budget is applied.
sents.zh: 在应用轨迹级预算之前，思考、行动和观察字段会分别进行缩短处理。

sents.en: The full prompt and target must also fit the 131,072-token training sequence limit.
sents.zh: 完整提示和目标也必须符合 131,072 个词符的训练序列限制。

paragraphs.en: We discard generations that terminate at the output-length limit, empty or failed generations, and prompt–target pairs that exceed the training sequence limit. Preprocessing removes surrounding whitespace, trailing termination markers, and a leading empty thinking block, while preserving nonempty thinking and the final answer. An end-of-turn token and newline are appended to each accepted target. All target tokens are supervised, including thinking and the end-of-turn suffix; all prompt tokens are masked. Rejected targets are not replaced with action-token supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们会丢弃在输出长度限制处终止的生成结果、空生成或失败的生成，以及超出训练序列限制的提示–目标对。 预处理会移除周围的空白字符、末尾的终止标记以及开头的空思考块，同时保留非空的思考和最终答案。 每个被接受的目标后都会追加一个回合结束令牌和换行符。 所有目标令牌都会被监督，包括思考和回合结束后缀；所有提示令牌都会被掩码。 被拒绝的目标不会被替换为动作令牌的监督内容。

sents.en: We discard generations that terminate at the output-length limit, empty or failed generations, and prompt–target pairs that exceed the training sequence limit.
sents.zh: 我们会丢弃在输出长度限制处终止的生成结果、空生成或失败的生成，以及超出训练序列限制的提示–目标对。

sents.en: Preprocessing removes surrounding whitespace, trailing termination markers, and a leading empty thinking block, while preserving nonempty thinking and the final answer.
sents.zh: 预处理会移除周围的空白字符、末尾的终止标记以及开头的空思考块，同时保留非空的思考和最终答案。

sents.en: An end-of-turn token and newline are appended to each accepted target.
sents.zh: 每个被接受的目标后都会追加一个回合结束令牌和换行符。

sents.en: All target tokens are supervised, including thinking and the end-of-turn suffix; all prompt tokens are masked.
sents.zh: 所有目标令牌都会被监督，包括思考和回合结束后缀；所有提示令牌都会被掩码。

sents.en: Rejected targets are not replaced with action-token supervision.
sents.zh: 被拒绝的目标不会被替换为动作令牌的监督内容。

paragraphs.en: To detect degenerate outputs, training stops after two consecutive batches in which the median target length falls below 100 tokens or more than 10% of targets contain at most 10 tokens. No minimum-length filter is applied to individual retrospections.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检测退化输出，当连续两个批次中目标长度的中位数低于 100 个词元，或超过 10% 的目标最多只包含 10 个词元时，训练将停止。 对单个回顾分析不应用最小长度过滤。

sents.en: To detect degenerate outputs, training stops after two consecutive batches in which the median target length falls below 100 tokens or more than 10% of targets contain at most 10 tokens.
sents.zh: 为了检测退化输出，当连续两个批次中目标长度的中位数低于 100 个词元，或超过 10% 的目标最多只包含 10 个词元时，训练将停止。

sents.en: No minimum-length filter is applied to individual retrospections.
sents.zh: 对单个回顾分析不应用最小长度过滤。

paragraphs.en: Each nominal update uses 64 source attempts and four retrospections per attempt, yielding up to 256 targets before rejection. We make one optimization pass through the retained targets and do not replay earlier batches. Source groups are consumed in completion order. We discard groups that began generation with weights more than one update behind the current policy. Serving weights are refreshed after each optimizer update, so a multi-turn attempt and its subsequent retrospections need not use a single frozen policy snapshot.
paragraphs.zh: 每次名义更新使用 64 个源尝试，每次尝试进行四次回溯，在拒绝前最多可生成 256 个目标。 我们对保留的目标进行一次优化处理，且不会重播早期的批次。 源组按完成顺序被消耗。 我们丢弃那些生成开始时权重落后于当前策略超过一次更新的组。 服务权重在每次优化器更新后都会刷新，因此一个多回合尝试及其后续的回溯无需使用单一的冻结策略快照。

sents.en: Each nominal update uses 64 source attempts and four retrospections per attempt, yielding up to 256 targets before rejection.
sents.zh: 每次名义更新使用 64 个源尝试，每次尝试进行四次回溯，在拒绝前最多可生成 256 个目标。

sents.en: We make one optimization pass through the retained targets and do not replay earlier batches.
sents.zh: 我们对保留的目标进行一次优化处理，且不会重播早期的批次。

sents.en: Source groups are consumed in completion order.
sents.zh: 源组按完成顺序被消耗。

sents.en: We discard groups that began generation with weights more than one update behind the current policy.
sents.zh: 我们丢弃那些生成开始时权重落后于当前策略超过一次更新的组。

sents.en: Serving weights are refreshed after each optimizer update, so a multi-turn attempt and its subsequent retrospections need not use a single frozen policy snapshot.
sents.zh: 服务权重在每次优化器更新后都会刷新，因此一个多回合尝试及其后续的回溯无需使用单一的冻结策略快照。

paragraphs.en: The objective in averages over all supervised tokens in the retained batch. We optimize all model parameters with AdamW, a constant learning rate of 10 10 , and no warmup. The data gradient is scaled by a constant factor of four before norm clipping. Relative token weighting is unchanged. We use neither a reference-policy KL penalty nor an entropy bonus. Optimizer settings and generation hyperparameters are summarized in .
paragraphs.zh: 目标是在保留的批次中所有监督标记上进行平均。 我们使用 AdamW 优化所有模型参数，学习率恒定为 10⁻¹⁰，且没有预热阶段。 在范数裁剪之前，数据梯度会乘以一个常数因子四。 相对标记权重保持不变。 我们没有使用参考策略的 KL 惩罚项，也没有使用熵奖励。 优化器设置和生成超参数总结在中。

sents.en: The objective in averages over all supervised tokens in the retained batch.

paragraphs.en: We compare ROFT with baselines spanning reinforcement learning (GRPO), distillation from teacher-generated explanations (CFT), context internalization (ERL), and self-critique-based revision (SCFT). Our GRPO baseline uses an enhanced variant previously shown to improve performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 ROFT 与多种基线方法进行了比较，这些方法涵盖了强化学习（GRPO）、从教师生成的解释中进行蒸馏（CFT）、上下文内化（ERL）以及基于自我批判的修订（SCFT）。 我们的 GRPO 基线方法使用了一种增强变体，该变体已被证明能够提升性能。

sents.en: We compare ROFT with baselines spanning reinforcement learning (GRPO), distillation from teacher-generated explanations (CFT), context internalization (ERL), and self-critique-based revision (SCFT).

sents.zh: 我们的 GRPO 基线方法使用了一种增强变体，该变体已被证明能够提升性能。

paragraphs.en: On SWE-bench Verified, ERL, CFT, SCFT, SSD, GRPO, and ROFT achieve solve rates of 45.6%, 46.0%, 46.8%, 47.0%, 48.0%, and 49.2%, respectively ( ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，ERL、CFT、SCFT、SSD、GRPO 和 ROFT 的解决率分别为 45.6%、46.0%、46.8%、47.0%、48.0% 和 49.2%（）。

paragraphs.en: We hypothesize that off-policy supervision contributes to the lower solve rates of ERL and CFT relative to ROFT. In ERL, successful reattempts are generated with a reflection that conveys privileged information, but this reflection is removed during context internalization, creating a mismatch between the contexts used to generate and train on the reattempt. In CFT, the critique targets are generated by a separate teacher model rather than the learner itself. This interpretation is consistent with our ROFT ablations: generating retrospections with a frozen base model yields lower held-out performance than using the evolving learner ( and ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们推测，离策略监督导致 ERL 和 CFT 的解决率低于 ROFT。 在 ERL 中，成功的重试是通过包含特权信息的反思生成的，但在上下文内化过程中会移除这种反思，从而造成用于生成重试和训练重试的上下文之间的不匹配。 在 CFT 中，批判的目标由一个独立的教师模型生成，而非学习者本身。 这一解释与我们的 ROFT 消融研究一致：使用冻结的基础模型生成回顾性分析，其保留集性能低于使用不断演化的学习者（和）。

paragraphs.en: The reward augments binary test success with task-specific shaping. Correctness-conditioned length control ( Aggarwal & Welleck, 2025 ) motivates preferring concise successful attempts without rewarding short failures. A successful, normally completed attempt receives R i = 1 − 0.1 ​ max ⁡ { 0 , log ⁡ ( N i / 8192 ) } R_{i}=1-0.1\max\{0,\log(N_{i}/8192)\} , where N i N_{i} is its total number of generated assistant tokens. The logarithmic penalty therefore applies only to successful completions exceeding 8,192 tokens. DAPO identifies reward noise from treating truncation as failure ( Yu et al., 2025 ) ; we instead give test-passing truncated attempts partial credit of 0.5 0.5 , preserving evidence of correctness while penalizing budget exhaustion. Failed attempts and other non-completed attempts receive zero. The logarithmic schedule and partial-credit value are our task-specific settings, not the reward functions proposed in those works.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励通过任务特定的塑造机制，增强了二元测试的成功性。 以正确性为条件的长度控制（Aggarwal & Welleck, 2025）促使系统优先选择简洁且成功的尝试，而不对简短的失败给予奖励。 一次成功且正常完成的尝试将获得 R i = 1 − 0.1 ​ max ⁡ { 0 , log ⁡ ( N i / 8192 ) } R_{i}=1-0.1\max\{0,\log(N_{i}/8192)\}，其中 N i N_{i} 是其生成的助手令牌总数。 因此，对数惩罚仅适用于超过 8,192 个令牌的成功完成尝试。 DAPO 通过将被截断视为失败来识别奖励噪声（Yu et al., 2025）；而我们则给予通过测试的截断尝试 0.5 的部分积分，既保留了正确性的证据，又对预算耗尽进行了惩罚。 失败的尝试及其他未完成尝试将获得零分。 对数规划表和部分积分值是我们针对该任务设定的参数，而非上述研究中提出的奖励函数。
